ne14:2.3: kā ca pakatikathāya desanā: cattāri saccāni,
ne14:2.5: “idaṃ dukkha”nti. ayaṃ paññatti pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ channaṃ dhātūnaṃ aṭṭhārasannaṃ dhātūnaṃ dvādasannaṃ āyatanānaṃ dasannaṃ indriyānaṃ nikkhepapaññatti.
ne14:3.1: “kabaliṃkāre ce bhikkhave āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandi atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ,
ne14:3.2: yattha patiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
ne14:3.3: yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti atthi tattha saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi.
ne14:3.4: yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi atthi tattha āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
ne14:3.5: yattha atthi āyatiṃ punabbhavābhi nibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ,
ne14:3.6: yattha atthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sasokaṃ taṃ bhikkhave sadaraṃ saupāyāsanti vadāmi,
ne14:4.3: viññāṇe ce bhikkhave āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandi atthi taṇhā patiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ,
ne14:4.4: yattha patiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
ne14:4.5: yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, atthi tattha saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi.
ne14:4.6: yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi, atthi tattha āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
ne14:4.7: yattha atthi āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ,
ne14:4.8: yattha atthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sasokaṃ taṃ bhikkhave sadaraṃ saupāyāsanti vadāmi”
ne14:4.9: ayaṃ pabhavapaññatti dukkhassa ca samudayassa ca.
ne14:5.1: “kabaliṃkāre ce bhikkhave āhāre natthi rāgo natthi nandi natthi taṇhā, appatiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ,
ne14:5.2: yattha appatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ, natthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
ne14:5.3: yattha natthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, natthi tattha saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi.
ne14:5.4: yattha natthi saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi, natthi tattha āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti,
ne14:5.5: yattha natthi āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti, natthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ,
ne14:5.6: yattha natthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ asokaṃ taṃ bhikkhave adaraṃ anupāyāsanti vadāmi.
ne14:6.3: viññāṇe ce bhikkhave āhāre natthi rāgo natthi nandi natthi taṇhā, appatiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ.
ne14:6.4: yattha appatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ, natthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
ne14:6.5: yattha natthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, natthi tattha saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi.
ne14:6.6: yattha natthi saṅkhārānaṃ vuḍḍhi, natthi tattha āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
ne14:6.7: yattha natthi āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti, natthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ,
ne14:6.8: yattha natthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ, asokaṃ taṃ bhikkhave adaraṃ anupāyāsanti vadāmi”
ne14:7.1: ayaṃ pariññāpaññatti dukkhassa, pahāna paññatti samudayassa, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, sacchikiriyāpaññatti nirodhassa.
ne14:8.2: appamatto nipako sato, samāhito bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
ne14:8.5: rūpā aniccāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
ne14:8.7: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
ne14:9.9: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.”
ne14:10.1: ayaṃ bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, pariññāpaññatti dukkhassa, pahānapaññatti samudayassa, sacchikiriyāpaññatti nirodhassa.
ne14:11.1: “rūpaṃ rādha vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷanikaṃ karotha (paññāya) taṇhakkhayāya paṭipajjatha.
ne14:11.5: saṅkhāre …pe… viññāṇaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷanikaṃ karotha (paññāya) taṇhakkhayāya paṭipajjatha.
ne14:12.1: ayaṃ nirodhapaññatti nirodhassa, nibbidāpaññatti assādassa, pariññāpaññatti dukkhassa, pahānapaññatti samudayassa, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, sacchikiriyāpaññatti nirodhassa.
ne14:13.1: “so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti”
ne14:14.1: ayaṃ paṭivedhapaññatti saccānaṃ, nikkhepapaññatti dassanabhūmiyā, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, sacchikiriyāpaññatti dassanabhūmiyā, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, sacchikiriyāpaññatti sotāpattiphalassa.
ne14:14.2: “so ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
ne14:14.4: ime āsavā asesaṃ nirujjhantīti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti”
ne14:15.1: ayaṃ uppādapaññatti khaye ñāṇassa, okāsapaññatti anuppāde ñāṇassa, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, pariññāpaññatti dukkhassa, pahānapaññatti samudayassa, ārambhapaññatti viriyindriyassa, āsāṭanāpaññatti āsāṭikānaṃ, nikkhepapaññatti bhāvanābhūmiyā, abhinighātapaññatti pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ.
ne14:16.1: “idaṃ dukkhanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi,
ne14:16.4: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi”
ne14:17.1: ayaṃ desanāpaññatti saccānaṃ, nikkhepapaññatti sutamayiyā paññāya, sacchikiriyāpaññatti anaññātaññassāmītindriyassa, pavattanāpaññatti dhammacakkassa.
ne14:18.1: “taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññeyyanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
ne14:18.2: so kho panāyaṃ dukkhasamudayo pahātabboti me bhikkhave …pe…
ne14:18.3: so kho panāyaṃ dukkhanirodho sacchikātabboti me bhikkhave …pe…
ne14:18.4: sā kho panāyaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā bhāvetabbāti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi”
ne14:19.1: ayaṃ bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, nikkhepapaññatti cintāmayiyā paññāya, sacchikiriyāpaññatti aññindriyassa.
ne14:20.1: “taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
ne14:20.2: so kho panāyaṃ dukkhasamudayo pahīnoti me bhikkhave …pe…
ne14:20.3: so kho panāyaṃ dukkhanirodho sacchikatoti me bhikkhave …pe…
ne14:20.4: sā kho panāyaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā bhāvitāti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi”
ne14:21.1: ayaṃ bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa, nikkhepapaññatti bhāvanāmayiyā paññāya, sacchikiriyāpaññatti aññātāvino indriyassa, pavattanāpaññatti dhammacakkassa.
ne14:23.8: ‘abhidā kavavamivattasambhava’nti abhinibbidāpaññatti cittassa, upādānapaññatti sabbaññutāya, padālanāpaññatti avijjaṇḍakosānaṃ.
ne14:25.1: ‘yo dukkha’nti vevacanapaññatti ca dukkhassa pariññāpaññatti ca,
ne14:25.2: ‘yato nidāna’nti pabhavapaññatti ca samudayassa pahānapaññatti ca,
ne14:25.4: kāmesu so jantu kathaṃ nameyyā’ti vevacanapaññatti ca kāmataṇhāya abhinivesa paññatti ca,
ne14:25.5: kāmāhi loke saṅgoti ñatvā’ti paccatthikato dassanapaññatti kāmānaṃ,
ne14:25.6: kāmā hi aṅgārakāsūpamā maṃsapesūpamā pāvakakappā papāta uragopamā ca.
ne14:25.7: ‘tesaṃ satimā’ ti apacayapaññatti pahānāya, nikkhepapaññatti kāyagatāya satiyā, bhāvanāpaññatti maggassa,
ne14:25.10: yadā hi yogī kāmā saṅgoti pajānāti,
ne14:25.11: so kāmānaṃ anuppādāya kusale dhamme uppādayati, so anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya vāyamati.
ne14:25.14: tattha so uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā. vāyamatī’ti ayaṃ appamādapaññatti bhāvanāya, nikkhepapaññatti viriyindriyassa, ārakkhapaññatti kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, ṭhitipaññatti adhicittasikkhāya.
ne14:27.3: upadhisambandhano bālo’ti pabhavapaññatti pāpakānaṃ icchāvacarānaṃ, kiccapaññatti pariyuṭṭhānānaṃ,
ne14:27.6: tamasā parivārito’ti desanāpaññatti avijjandhakārassa vevacanapaññatti ca.
ne14:27.7: assirī viya khāyatī’ti dassanapaññatti dibbacakkhussa, nikkhepapaññatti paññācakkhussa,
ne14:27.8: ‘passato natthi kiñcana’nti paṭivedhapaññatti sattānaṃ, rāgo kiñcanaṃ doso kiñcanaṃ moho kiñcanaṃ.
ne14:28.1: “atthi bhikkhave ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ, no ce taṃ bhikkhave abhavissa ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ,
ne14:28.2: na idha jātassa bhūtassa katassa saṅkhatassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyetha.
ne14:28.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ, tasmā jātassa bhūtassa katassa saṅkhatassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyatī”ti.
ne14:29.1: ‘no cetaṃ bhikkhave abhavissa ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhata’nti desanāpaññatti nibbānassa vevacanapaññatti ca,
ne14:29.2: ‘na idha jātassa bhūtassa katassa saṅkhatassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyethā’ti vevacanapaññatti saṅkhatassa upanayana paññatti ca,
ne14:29.3: ‘yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhata’nti vevacanapaññatti nibbānassa jotanāpaññatti ca,
ne14:29.4: ‘tasmā jātassa bhūtassa katassa saṅkhatassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyatī’ti ayaṃ vevacanapaññatti nibbānassa, nīyāṇikapaññatti maggassa, nissaraṇapaññatti saṃsārato.
ne14:29.5: tenāha bhagavā: ‘no ce taṃ bhikkhave abhavissā’ti.
ne14:29.6: tenāha āyasmā mahākaccāyano: “ekaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ paññattīhi vividhāhi desetī”ti.
